data.one_liner: Widget that adds a drop shadow effect to an image with customizable properties.
data.what_it_does: Provides a DropShadowImage widget that renders an image with a configurable shadow offset, blur, scale and border radius. All properties are set via constructor parameters, making it easy to integrate into any layout.
use_when: You need a simple drop‑shadow effect for local or network images without writing custom painters.
You want quick visual styling with adjustable offset, blur and border radius.
avoid_when: You require advanced image processing like cropping, filtering, or caching.
Performance is critical and you need a highly optimized solution.
strengths: Very easy to use – just wrap your Image in DropShadowImage.
Many shadow properties are exposed for fine‑grained control.
Pure Dart, no native platform setup required.
weaknesses: Only provides shadow effect – no other image utilities.
Limited to static images; no built‑in caching or network handling.

alternatives.name: image
alternatives.why_pick_it: Core image manipulation library; you can draw shadows manually with a CustomPainter if you need more control.
